component.name: Dead Man's Switch
component.summary: Shuts the PC down unless you keep confirming you're there

description.p: Leave a machine running for a download, a render or a game server without it staying on all night if you fall asleep or walk away. A countdown asks you to confirm you're still there; if nobody does, a final warning pops up, and then the PC shuts down, restarts or hibernates.

ul.li: Set the check interval, the final warning and what happens at the end
Pause the timer, or keep it running in the tray
Press Space during the final warning to keep the PC on
